decisions.reason: The declared external connector contract in inputs/requirements.txt requires J1 pin 2 to be the filter input, J1 pin 1 to be the filtered output, and J1 pin 3 to be ground. Saved schematic and board connectivity connect J1.1 to /IN (series resistor R1.1) and J1.2 to /OUT (filtered RC node at R1.2 and C1.1), swapping J1 pin 1 and J1 pin 2 relative to the required contract.
